Hot 3.0.1 fixes the issues found in a full review of everything merged after 3.0.0: the language and type checker, the JIT and interpreter, hot-std and the store, the App, the API, workers, scheduler and queues, the CLI, formatter and language server, and the release tooling and dependencies.

Read the [3.0.0 to 3.0.1 upgrade guide](https://hot.dev/docs/migrations#upgrading-from-3-0-0-to-3-0-1) before you upgrade.

## Breaking

- **Management credentials are retired.** Migration 020 revokes every `hm_` credential and deactivates the environment keys one issued, and `/v1/management/*` returns 410 Gone. Use org API keys and `/v1/orgs`; version 1.3.0 of every SDK wraps them. The upgrade guide has a query that lists the affected keys.
- **Code that 3.0.0 accepted can fail to compile:** non-exhaustive matches on closed literal unions and on enum-returning calls, unresolved bare names and unknown closed-enum variants in meta, a non-integer `timeout`, one-time `schedule` strings, self-referential type aliases, arrows that add variants to closed enums, a `pkg.hot` that isn't literal data, package paths outside the package, and a few more. Run `hot check` with the 3.0.1 CLI before you roll out workers: a deployed bundle that contains one fails until you fix it and redeploy.
- **Behaviour changes:** compiled code now gives the interpreter's results; `is-zero`, `mod`, `flatten` and store Dec values change; `hot fmt` refuses files it can't format safely and drops `--force`; `hot check` exits 2 when it can't run; only the service commands daemonize; several `/v1` responses use new status codes. The upgrade guide lists them all.
- **Packages:** hot-std 3.0.1 and hot-ai-agent 1.5.0 require Hot 3.0.1.

## Upgrade

- **PostgreSQL** applies migrations 017 to 023 as a rolling upgrade: run `hot db migrate` with the 3.0.1 CLI while 3.0.0 serves, re-run the 3.0.1 `provision_runtime.sql`, then roll the services, workers first. 3.0.1 services refuse to start without the runtime grants. Migrations 019, 021 and 023 block writes to the tables they index while they run. See [Upgrading from Hot 3.0.0](https://hot.dev/docs/configuration/postgres#upgrading-from-hot-300).
- **SQLite** databases are copied to `<db>.pre-migrate.bak` before they migrate.
- **Self-host bundle:** re-render it for the fixed Valkey healthcheck, read-only nginx, and `HOT_APP_URL`/`HOT_API_URL`.

## Fixes

- **Security:** stored and reflected XSS in the App's streams, API-key, event, run and webhook pages; six RustSec advisories (zip, ctutils, crypto-bigint, pulldown-cmark); `set-secret` values masked in call records. Report vulnerabilities to security@hot.dev.
- **JIT:** a use-after-free in collecting flows that crashed workers, inner bindings that leaked into outer scopes, alias calls resolved by a global name scan, stack guards on deep first calls, and memory use with many enum variants.
- **Runtime and store:** `put-if` on Decs, exact Dec storage, parallel flows in lambdas and their result order, linear map builders, and a 5x faster `map` over large vectors.
- **Platform:** streams deliver `run:start` first and each event once; Redis queues keep held and retried work and recover from restarts; a crashed worker's events re-run; MCP binds named arguments in declared order on PostgreSQL; dynamic schedules receive their `args`; Hot Box tasks cancel and pull correctly.
- **CLI and tools:** `hot fmt` keeps block strings, meta comments and trailing commas; the language server uses UTF-16 positions and adds formatting and workspace symbols; `hot deploy -p` and the `HOT_WORKER_*` variables work.
- **Docs and skills:** corrected examples and std references, and SDK docs for 1.3.0.

## Dependencies

cranelift 0.137, rustyline 19, jsonschema 0.60, parking_lot 0.13, google-cloud-storage 1.21, tower-lsp-server 0.23 and Tailwind 4.3.3. Release builds use `--locked`, the `.deb` no longer depends on `libssl3t64`, and GitHub actions and CI images are pinned.
